title: No 504 Plan and has a 504 Program
description: No 504 Plan and has a 504 Program - This query will give you all the students who do NOT have a 504 Plan but do HAVE a 504 Program. They need a Plan and then remove the Program.
code: LIST STU SC? ID LN FN 504_PLAN 504_PRG BY STU.SC IF 504_PLAN = NO AND 504_PRG = YES
